bands.name: plain
bands.note: No avoidable drafting words, or so few they do not shape the sentence.

bands.name: light
bands.note: A drafting word or two. Ordinary in a form, and readable.

bands.name: heavy
bands.note: The drafting is doing the work. A reader will notice the effort.

bands.name: dense
bands.note: More drafting than content. Rewrite before anyone signs it.
